- GuardianBot k = .search k (plays opp (.bot CooperateBot) D) (.const D)(.const C).
- PrudentBot k = .search k (plays opp self C) (.search k (plays opp (.bot DefectBot) D)(.const C)(.const D)) (.const D).
- Both guards are TRUE but unprovable at budget k (certificate pays search_f floor ≥ k > k).
  So GuardianBot cooperates (else C), PrudentBot's outer guard fails → defects (else D).
KEY TECHNIQUE for "guard TRUE but unprovable at budget k": use no_provable_tailToS_floor
  with singleton S = (· = target atom). The five readable-shape kills are ACTION-refined:
  searchBranch reads THEN action, our target is the ELSE action → hsb holds since then-branch
  const ≠ target action. For stacked-search (PrudentBot), hsts holds since inner-then const C ≠ D.
  Atom-killer: cases on PlaysProof; search_t branch either gives wrong-action const (cases closes)
  or an inner search_f paying floor; search_f pays floor → omega on n ≤ K ≤ k.
  This works even when the guard interp is TRUE (unlike no_provable_searcherPlay_tail which needs hfalse).
The 10 shape obligations: hplays/hatom/hsb/hsim/hbotsim/hbotsearch/hibs/hsts/hplug/hctx.
  hplug/hctx: case on List L (nil + cons up to enough depth), simp [searchPlug/ctxPlug] discharges.
